name: oh-my-claudeagent
description: Claude Code, with receipts. Plans with you, hands each task to a specialist agent, and keeps a session from calling work done until a verification is logged.

enableKeywordTriggers.title: Enable keyword triggers
enableKeywordTriggers.description: Adds a one-line hint naming the slash command when a prompt contains a trigger phrase such as "create plan".

statuslineMode.title: Statusline mode
statuslineMode.description: on lets /oh-my-claudeagent:omca-setup point your status line and the subagent status line at OMCA's renderer; off makes setup leave both alone.

disableForceOrchestrationStyle.title: Disable forced orchestration output style
disableForceOrchestrationStyle.description: When true, removes the force-for-plugin: true line from the installed output-styles/omca-default.md cache copy so your own outputStyle setting takes precedence instead of the plugin's orchestration style. The strip is applied at /oh-my-claudeagent:omca-setup time; you must re-run omca-setup after every plugin update (or /plugin marketplace update omca) because the cache copy may be overwritten and the strip will need re-application.

showBand.title: Show the band above the prompt
showBand.description: When false, the band with the bound plan, the last verification and the suggested next actions is not drawn.

guardMode.title: Destructive Bash guard mode
guardMode.description: dialog asks before a risky Bash or PowerShell command runs where a dialog can show; deny, and any session where none can show, refuses a blocking command and lets an advisory one run. A catastrophic removal is refused in both modes.
